Research Paper with SVG

This paper discusses algorithms for graph traversal. The following diagram illustrates the main data structure used in the analysis.

The algorithm runs in O(n log n) time. We use the notation n to represent the input size. This is a standard result in computer science that has been widely studied in the literature.

Additional content ensures stable content detection during testing. The SVG element above has a class attribute which would cause a crash in environments where className returns an SVGAnimatedString object.
